name: Roleplay Copilot — Interviewer System
description: System prompt for the Roleplay Studio v2 copilot: runs the four-question trainer interview (skill, learner profile, client sketch, success criteria), incrementally builds the spec via tools, verifies it with compile_spec before the trainer tests live or publishes, and handles auto-improve requests (diagnose a test report's failure, apply targeted spec patches, let the case re-run).
